title: New on OTT in India, 12-13 Nov 2026: Jailer 2 (Prime Video), Heartland (Netflix), Student of the Year: After Dark (JioHotstar), Parivarik ManuRanjan (Sony LIV), Bandra (ZEE5)
headline: SOTY: After Dark and 4 More on OTT This Weekend
caption:
Five of the new titles on OTT in India this weekend, from Thursday 12 to Friday 13 November.

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has been streaming on Prime Video since Thursday, four weeks after it opened in cinemas on 15 October. You can watch it in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam or Kannada.

On Friday, ZEE5 starts Bandra, the 2023 Malayalam film with Dileep and Tamannaah Bhatia, in its first streaming release. Netflix has Heartland, a thriller in which Jessica Chastain plays a former country music star searching for her missing niece. JioHotstar begins Student of the Year: After Dark, a Hindi thriller series directed by Reema Maya, and Sony LIV premieres Parivarik ManuRanjan, its original Hindi family comedy with Pankaj Tripathi and Aditi Rao Hydari.

How many of these five streaming services does your home pay for right now?

Sources: Prime Video India, ZEE5, Sony LIV, JioHotstar, Netflix Tudum, The Week, The Hollywood Reporter India, Esquire India, Medianews4u, Sacnilk, NewsBytes
